requirements.text: Пользователь может выбрать поставщика при создании или редактировании продукта.
notes: Selection uses supplier records that already exist or are seeded in the mock data for this slice; supplier creation itself is covered by REQ-010.
Seeded supplier records must match the current generated Supplier model exactly. In the current kit this normally means id, name, and contact_email; do not invent email/phone fields.

Browser/e2e should select supplier options that actually exist in the rendered select. It should wait for option presence and use selectOption({ label: supplierName }) for label-based selection, or select by actual option value.
